problem: A,B,C,D = construct_r_trapezoid_q(8,4,2), E = construct_on_line(D,B), E = construct_lc_tangent(C,D)
necessary_constructions: A,B,C,D = construct_r_trapezoid_q(8,4,2), E = construct_on_line(D,B), E = construct_lc_tangent(C,D)
proof:
Solution:
1. Length_C_D - 2 & Length_A_B - 8 => Length_A_B/Length_C_D - 4
2. Collinear(B,D,E) => Angle_B_D_C - Angle_C_D_E & Angle_A_D_B - Angle_A_D_E
3. Parallel(A,B,C,D) => Angle_A_B_C + Angle_B_C_D - pi
4. Angle_A_B_C - Angle_A_B_D - Angle_C_B_D & Angle_B_C_D + Angle_B_D_C + Angle_C_B_D - pi & Angle_B_D_C - Angle_C_D_E & Angle_A_B_C + Angle_B_C_D - pi => Angle_A_B_D - Angle_C_D_E
5. Angle_B_A_D - pi/2 => Perpendicular(A,B,A,D)
6. Perpendicular(C,D,C,E) & Parallel(A,B,C,D) => Perpendicular(A,B,C,E)
7. Perpendicular(A,B,A,D) & Perpendicular(A,B,C,E) => Parallel(A,D,C,E)
8. Parallel(A,D,C,E) => Angle_A_E_C + Angle_D_A_E - pi
9. Angle_A_D_B - Angle_A_D_E & Angle_A_D_E + Angle_A_E_D + Angle_D_A_E - pi & Angle_A_E_C + Angle_D_A_E - pi & Angle_A_E_C - Angle_A_E_D - Angle_C_E_D => Angle_A_D_B - Angle_C_E_D
10. Angle_A_B_D - Angle_C_D_E & Angle_A_D_B - Angle_C_E_D => Similar3(A,B,D,C,D,E)
11. Similar3(A,B,D,C,D,E) => Length_A_B/Length_A_D - Length_C_D/Length_C_E
12. Perpendicular(A,B,A,D) & Parallel(A,B,C,D) => Perpendicular(A,D,C,D)
13. Perpendicular(A,D,C,D) => Angle_A_D_C - pi/2
14. Angle_A_D_C - pi/2 & Angle_B_A_D - pi/2 => Angle_A_D_C - Angle_B_A_D
15. Length_A_B/Length_A_D - Length_A_D/Length_C_D & -Angle_A_D_C + Angle_B_A_D => Similar3(A,B,D,D,A,C)
16. Similar3(A,B,D,D,A,C) => Length_A_B/Length_A_D - Length_A_D/Length_C_D
17. Length_A_B/Length_C_D - 4 & Length_A_B/Length_A_D - Length_C_D/Length_C_E & Length_A_B/Length_A_D - Length_A_D/Length_C_D => Length_A_B - 8*Length_C_E
18. Length_A_B - 8*Length_C_E & Length_A_B - 8 => Length_C_E - 1
19. Perpendicular(C,D,C,E) => Angle_D_C_E - pi/2
20. Angle_D_C_E - pi/2 => Area_C_D_E - Length_C_D*Length_C_E/2
21. Length_C_E - 1 & Area_C_D_E - Length_C_D*Length_C_E/2 & Length_C_D - 2 => Area_C_D_E - 1
